from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('barcode.png')
p=list(im.crop((0,100,1000,101)).getdata())
print('Mean RGB',tuple(round(sum(v[c] for v in p)/len(p),1) for c in range(3)))
print('ten segment means',[tuple(round(sum(v[c] for v in p[i:i+100])/100) for c in range(3)) for i in range(0,1000,100)])
PY"
